name: Verto Software Key Manager for WooCommerce
author: vertorocks

sections.description:
Verto Software Key Manager for WooCommerce is a free single-store license key inventory and delivery plugin.

The free plugin is fully usable for one WooCommerce store. It does not contain trial limits, key quotas, time limits, remote key services, master/child connections, or license-gated features.

Features

  • Local license-key inventory stored on your WordPress site.
  • Product search by name, SKU, or ID when uploading keys.
  • Automatic key assignment when an order reaches Processing.
  • All-or-nothing assignment: an order is not partially fulfilled when stock is insufficient.
  • License keys in WooCommerce customer emails.
  • Buyers & Keys delivery history with actual assignment time for new deliveries.
  • Per-product key delivery enable/disable.
  • Per-product low-stock alert enable/disable.
  • Configurable low-stock threshold and alert email.
  • Actionable insufficient-stock admin email with a direct order link and retry instructions.
  • CSV export for all keys or a single product.
  • Zero-stock and deleted-product inventory handling.
  • Manual Assign / retry license keys order action after inventory is replenished.
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatible.
  • WPML-aware shared inventory: translated versions of a product use the same canonical key pool when WPML is active.
  • Translation-ready using standard WordPress internationalization.

Important: insufficient key stock

If an order needs more keys than are available, no keys are assigned and the order remains in Processing.

After adding the missing keys in Key Manager > Upload, open the WooCommerce order and use:

Order actions > Assign / retry license keys

Do not manually change an incomplete managed order to Completed. The plugin blocks Completed status until all required license keys have been assigned.

Data and privacy

License keys and delivery history are stored locally on your WordPress/WooCommerce installation. The plugin does not send license keys to an external service.

Deactivating or deleting the plugin does not automatically delete the key inventory. This is intentional to reduce the risk of accidental loss of license inventory.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload and activate Verto Software Key Manager for WooCommerce.
  3. Go to Key Manager > Upload and add license keys to a product.
  4. Uploading keys enables software key delivery for that product.
  5. Review Key Manager > Settings, including the alert email and low-stock threshold.
  6. Place a test order before using the plugin in production.
sections.faq:
What happens if an order needs two keys but only one is available?

No keys are assigned. The order remains in Processing and the available key stays in inventory. The administrator receives an insufficient-license-keys email. Add enough keys, then use Order actions > Assign / retry license keys.

Can I simply mark an incomplete order Completed after adding keys?

No. Use Assign / retry license keys. This performs a fresh stock check, assigns the complete set of keys, and then allows the order to complete.

Why can I receive both an insufficient-stock email and a low-stock email?

They report different events. The insufficient-stock email means a specific order could not be fulfilled. A later low-stock email means the retry succeeded but the remaining inventory has reached the configured low-stock threshold.

Does it work with HPOS?

Yes. The plugin uses WooCommerce order APIs and declares HPOS compatibility.

Does it work with WPML?

The plugin is WPML-aware. When WPML is active, translated versions of the same product resolve to the default-language product and share one license-key inventory. Plugin interface strings use the standard WordPress gettext API and the verto-software-key-manager-for-woocommerce text domain, making them available to WordPress language packs and translation tools such as WPML String Translation.

Does uninstalling delete my license keys?

No. The plugin intentionally preserves its database table and settings to avoid accidental destruction of license inventory.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First stable WordPress.org-ready release.
  • Completed security review of administrator actions: capability checks, nonces, input sanitization and output escaping.
  • Added an explicit WooCommerce product-save capability and nonce check.
  • Completed gettext coverage for plugin administration screens, customer key output, notices and order notes.
  • Retained HPOS compatibility and WPML-aware canonical product inventory.
  • Preserved the tested all-or-nothing assignment, insufficient-stock notification, manual retry, customer delivery and low-stock workflow.
  • Buyers & Keys records the actual assignment time for new deliveries.

0.9.5

  • WordPress.org release-candidate packaging and documentation refresh.
  • Buyers & Keys now records and displays the actual assignment time for new key deliveries, including manual retry assignments.
  • Existing historical rows without an assignment timestamp continue to fall back to the order creation time.
  • Corrected the internal plugin version constant to match the release version.
  • Added Domain Path metadata for translations.
  • Preserved the tested 0.9.4 insufficient-stock, retry, customer-delivery and low-stock workflow.

0.9.4

  • Separated insufficient-order notifications from low-stock alerts.
  • Added immediate actionable HTML admin email with Required, Available, Missing, Assigned and clickable order link.
  • Insufficient notification is sent after critical order processing and does not alter checkout.

0.9.3

  • Added immediate actionable insufficient-stock administrator email.
  • Added order number/link, product, required and available quantities, and exact Upload + Assign / retry recovery steps.
  • Prevented a duplicate generic low-stock email for the same insufficient-stock event.

0.9.2

  • Prevented insufficient-stock administrator email delivery from running inside the checkout request.
  • Kept mail transport failures outside the critical checkout path.

0.9.1

  • Added actionable insufficient-license-key administrator email.
  • Added direct WooCommerce order link and Key Manager > Upload / Assign-retry instructions.
  • Updated plugin identity to Verto, with Bombardi OÜ support contact.

0.9.0

  • WordPress.org release-candidate build based on the tested single-store workflow.
  • Added WordPress.org metadata and GPL information.
  • Updated text domain to match the plugin slug.
  • Declared WooCommerce dependency and HPOS compatibility.
  • Added WPML-aware canonical product mapping so translations share one key inventory.
  • Preserved all-or-nothing key assignment and manual retry workflow.

0.1.3

  • Added WooCommerce order action to assign/retry missing license keys after stock is replenished.
  • Blocks incomplete managed orders from remaining Completed.
  • Suppresses Completed customer email when required keys are missing.
  • Manual retry preserves all-or-nothing assignment.

0.1.0

  • Initial free single-store build.
